reasoningText.text: User repeated same request many times. Likely stuck loop due to not providing doctor name or appointment ID. We could offer to check the clinic calendar for a doctor or ask which doctor. We should also mention we can't find appointment without doctor or ID. Offer to list all scheduled appointments if any.

content.text:
I’m happy to help, but I need a little more detail to find the exact slot for you. Can you let me know one of the following?

| What you can provide | How it helps |
|-----------------------|--------------|
| **Doctor’s name** (e.g., *Dr. Srinivasa*) | I’ll pull the scheduled appointment for you. |
| **Appointment ID** (the unique reference number on your confirmation) | I’ll fetch the date, time, and location. |
| **General request** – “Show me all my upcoming appointments” | I’ll list every scheduled slot you have, so you can pick the one you need. |

If you’re unsure, just reply with the doctor’s name, and I’ll retrieve your appointment details right away. Let me know!
